stories.title: ‘It can’t be that Hindi won’t be taught’: SC to Tamil Nadu over Navodaya schools

en.title: 'It can't be that Hindi won't be taught': SC to Tamil Nadu over Navodaya schools
en.summary: India's Supreme Court has questioned Tamil Nadu regarding Hindi language instruction at Navodaya schools, suggesting that Hindi education cannot be excluded from the curriculum.

stories.title: Tata Sons board backs five-year extension for Chandrasekaran; Noel Tata opposes

en.title: Tata Sons board backs five-year extension for Chandrasekaran; Noel Tata opposes
en.summary: The Tata Sons board has approved a five-year extension for N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman, though board member Noel Tata has opposed this decision.

stories.title: Tata Sons reverses course, reappoints Chandrasekaran as chairman for another 5 yrs

en.title: Tata Sons reverses course, reappoints Chandrasekaran as chairman for another 5 yrs
en.summary: Tata Sons has approved a fresh five-year term for N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman after reversing his earlier decision against reappointment. His current term ends in February 2027.

stories.title: Semicon India 2026: India’s semiconductor ecosystem expanding; opening new opportunities, says Modi

en.title: Semicon India 2026: India's semiconductor ecosystem expanding; opening new opportunities, says Modi
en.summary: At the SEMICON India 2026 inauguration, Prime Minister Modi stated that India's semiconductor sector is experiencing rapid expansion and creating new opportunities for investment and growth.

stories.title: Supreme Court expresses shock over deaths in relief camps in Manipur, asks Chief Secretary to respond

en.title: Supreme Court expresses shock over deaths in relief camps in Manipur, asks Chief Secretary to respond
en.summary: India's Supreme Court responded with concern to deaths occurring in relief camps in Manipur. The court directed authorities to investigate cases promptly and guarantee the protection and dignity of displaced persons in the camps.

stories.title: Delhi SIR: Supreme Court to hear plea seeking names, reasons for notices

en.title: Delhi SIR: Supreme Court to hear plea seeking names, reasons for notices
en.summary: The Supreme Court will hear a petition requesting disclosure of names and justifications behind notices issued in a Delhi matter.

stories.title: Supreme Court pulls up Manipur over 25 unnatural deaths in relief camps

en.title: Supreme Court pulls up Manipur over 25 unnatural deaths in relief camps
en.summary: India's Supreme Court censured Manipur authorities regarding 25 unnatural deaths that occurred in relief camps.

stories.title: ‘India, buy your oil elsewhere’: Senator after US House passes Russia sanctions bill

en.title: 'India, buy your oil elsewhere': Senator after US House passes Russia sanctions bill
en.summary: A U.S. senator made a statement directed at India regarding oil purchases following the U.S. House passage of legislation imposing sanctions on Russia.

stories.title: ‘What did you do in the past year?’ NGT asks Tamil Nadu govt. over Vinayaka idol immersion preparedness

en.title: 'What did you do in the past year?' NGT asks Tamil Nadu govt. over Vinayaka idol immersion preparedness
en.summary: India's National Green Tribunal questioned Tamil Nadu's government about compliance with environmental guidelines for Vinayaka idol immersion during the previous year's festival. The state requested additional time to file documentation confirming adherence to established protocols.

stories.title: US senator's 'clean up your act' warning to India, China over Russia

en.title: US senator's 'clean up your act' warning to India, China over Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives passed legislation authorizing potential tariffs up to 100% on goods from nations purchasing Russian energy, aimed at restricting Moscow's revenue. The bill passed with significant support but reflected divided opinions on presidential trade authority.

stories.title: India, China To Face New Trump Tariffs? US House Passes Russia Sanctions Bill

en.title: India, China To Face New Trump Tariffs? US House Passes Russia Sanctions Bill
en.summary: The US House has passed a Russia sanctions bill that Trump has indicated he will sign, following its Senate approval by a large margin.

stories.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu

en.title: 2 Dead In 2 Days During Clashes Over Ganesh Chaturthi Procession In Tamil Nadu
en.summary: Two deaths occurred within two days in Tamil Nadu during disputes related to Ganesh Chaturthi processions. Incidents took place in different cities including a killing in Cuddalore following a dispute in Chennai.

stories.title: Rentomojo shares jump 9% after listing at 19% premium over IPO price. Can the debut-day mojo last?

en.title: Rentomojo shares jump 9% after listing at 19% premium over IPO price. Can the debut-day mojo last?
en.summary: Rentomojo shares rose sharply on their stock market debut, listing at a premium and gaining further to reach Rs 526.70. Market analysts acknowledge growth potential but caution investors about elevated valuations following the strong opening-day performance.

stories.title: Juniper Hotels shares rise 2% on proposed Rs 248 crore acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa

en.title: Juniper Hotels shares rise 2% on proposed Rs 248 crore acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa
en.summary: Juniper Hotels announced plans to acquire the operating Novotel Imagicaa hotel in Maharashtra for Rs 248 crore, a 287-key property in Khopoli spanning 11 acres with dining and event facilities. The acquisition aims to strengthen Juniper's footprint in the Mumbai-Pune corridor.

stories.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 23,300 despite Fed rate hike. Why bears may be ready to pounce

en.title: Sensex rises 200 points, Nifty above 23,300 despite Fed rate hike. Why bears may be ready to pounce
en.summary: Indian benchmark indices gained ground despite the US Federal Reserve's first rate increase in three years, driven by buying across non-IT sectors. Analysts caution that high bond yields, foreign fund outflows, rupee depreciation and geopolitical tensions could trigger future market volatility.

stories.title: Kaynes Tech, Syrma SGS, MosChip, others rally up to 10% as PM Modi set to inaugurate Semicon 2026

en.title: Kaynes Tech, Syrma SGS, MosChip, others rally up to 10% as PM Modi set to inaugurate Semicon 2026
en.summary: Semiconductor stocks including Kaynes Technology, Syrma SGS Technology and MosChip Technologies surged up to 10% as investors focused on India's semiconductor sector ahead of Prime Minister Modi's inauguration of Semicon India 2026.

stories.title: GMR Airports shares gain 2% after JM Financial retains Buy rating; sees up to 24% upside

en.title: GMR Airports shares gain 2% after JM Financial retains Buy rating; sees up to 24% upside
en.summary: GMR Airports shares rose following JM Financial's maintained Buy rating with a Rs 115 target price, citing improved risk-reward dynamics. The brokerage expects passenger traffic pressure to ease from December onwards due to favorable comparisons and steady international traffic.
